scope: Synthetic usage and context packets; official dated API prices are stored separately. No native model calls, measured compliance/attention or performance-equivalent routing claim.
inputGrowth: Linear integer interpolation between consecutive per-agent endpoint input snapshots, ending exactly at the existing R11 snapshot. Initial worker has no result history.
prefix: Per-agent base+tools+guidance+skills; first call writes it, later calls read it. Other input fresh; short TTL, eligible explicit stable boundary assumed. No cross-agent/provider cache sharing.

cacheChart.scale: One linear USD scale across all16 bars; model rates held fixed for the checked date.

componentExamples: Assigned full-packet budgets sum to the category. Displayed excerpts are not tokenized full packets. Shared relevant skill budgets stay1200+600; uncurated adds4200 unrelated body tokens.
authority: Scenario role interpretation; actual authority depends on native roles. Toy scores omit learned role effects. Presence is inspectable, compliance/confidence unmeasured.
